| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `zode acp` | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server |
| `zode mcp` | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers |
| `zode [project]` | start zode tui |
| `zode attach <url>` | attach to a running zode server |
| `zode run [message..]` | run zode with a message |
| `zode debug` | debugging and troubleshooting tools |
| `zode auth` | manage AI providers and credentials |
| `zode agent` | manage agents |
| `zode upgrade [target]` | upgrade zode to the latest or a specific version |
| `zode uninstall` | uninstall zode and remove all related files |
| `zode serve` | starts a headless zode server |
| `zode models [provider]` | list all available models |
| `zode roll-call <filter>` | batch-test text models matching a filter for connectivity and latency |
| `zode profile` | show Zode account profile |
| `zode stats` | show token usage and cost statistics |
| `zode export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON |
| `zode import <file>` | import session data from JSON file or URL |
| `zode pr <number>` | fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run zode |
| `zode session` | manage sessions |
| `zode remote` | enable remote connection for real-time session relay |
| `zode daemon` | manage the local zode daemon |
| `zode console` | open the local Zode Console |
| `zode db` | database tools |
| `zode config` | configuration tools |
| `zode plugin <module>` | install plugin and update config |
| `zode help [command]` | show full CLI reference |
| `zode completion` | generate shell completion script |
